content_zh:
第十一章 黄背心
这场比赛最终还是没能踢完，大概曼多利尼教练是实在无法忍受场上一些球员的拙劣表现了，下半场刚打来了十几分钟就宣布了比赛结束。
走的时候，曼多利尼的心里是痛并快乐着，迪甘的表现让他眼前一亮，对新赛季球队的前景充满了希望，此外帕奇尼，拉扎里，以及主力一方的阿尔贝蒂尼，蒙托利沃的表现也都非常出色。
但是某些人实在是让他大失所望，在球场上的表现甚至连小学生都不如，可以预见新赛季还没开始，一些人就已经彻底失去位置了。
迪甘对自己今天的表现也非常满意，那个进球之后，他在上半场临近结束的时候，又用禁区外一脚远射轰开了泰比把守的球门。
到了下半场，他的表现依然抢眼，先是边路传中，准确的找到了后点的帕奇尼，推射破门，紧接着帕奇尼投桃报李，禁区内横穿，助攻迪甘完成了帽子戏法。
主力一方则由阿尔贝蒂尼两次任意球攻门得到了两分，当今世界足坛，人们提到任意球大师的时候，只会想到贝克汉姆的贝氏弧线，却不知道阿尔贝蒂尼的落叶球同样独步天下。
比赛被喊停了，迪甘虽然还没过瘾，但也是无可奈何，和帕奇尼这个好基友勾肩搭背，嘻嘻哈哈的朝更衣室走去。
“罗德！你今天的表现简直太棒了，我现在都有些迫不及待希望新赛季快些开始，让那些甲级球队通通大吃一惊！”
迪甘笑道：“詹保罗！别忘了，我们现在也是甲级球队了！”
帕奇尼一愣，随即笑了，抓了抓毛寸，道：“要不是你提醒我都要忘了，真是太棒了，我也要踢意甲的比赛了，罗德！我们会是意甲赛场上最棒的锋线搭档！所有球队的后防线都要被我们碾碎！”
“别太得意了，臭小子！一场训练比赛表现出色，根本就算不上什么，你们还差的远呢！”
绍达蒂从后面走了过来，对着两人冷哼一声，仰头走了过去。
帕奇尼就好像发现了新大陆的哥伦布一样，满脸疑惑的看着迪甘：“他有什么好神气的，刚才他在场上的表现简直就像个小丑一样！”
迪甘却没当回事儿，斗败了的柴狗当然要汪汪叫上几声，胜者谁会把这个当回事儿：“别理他！我才他今天肯定是来月经了，看他走路的样子，都像是夹着卫生巾！”
帕奇尼被迪甘的形容逗得一阵大笑，两个人谁都没看见绍达蒂的脸色黑的都能去演包青天了。
洗过澡，拒绝了帕奇尼一起去喝一杯的邀请，迪甘就要回家了，新赛季就要开始了，他可不希望因为一些球场之外的事情给曼多利尼留下坏印象。
亚特兰大俱乐部给他租了房子，距离球队的训练场并不算远，迪甘也就没开车，而是跑步回去，现在这具身体的底子非常出色，只是没练出来，迪甘想要在新赛季扬名立万，没有个好身体可不行，他要抓紧时间将身体调整到最佳状态，等到赛季开始之后，让所有人都大吃一惊。
迪甘走了，却留给了曼多利尼一个难题，迪甘该踢什么位置，从今天的表现来看，边锋，组织性中场，前锋，每个位置迪甘都能胜任。
这也要多亏了迪甘前世的丰富经历，最开始的时候，他就是踢中锋的，只是因为身体单薄，还有那悲催的身高才换了位置。

成都谢菲联的主教练因为他的速度奇快，就安排他踢边锋，但是迪甘并不是很喜欢这个位置，就又变成了组织型中场。
如果将迪甘放在中场的位置上，虽然能发挥他的技术和组织特长，但是却浪费了他的得分能力，将他放在边锋的位置上，球场的左路通道是占据了，可是谁也不能保证球队的前锋能够把迪甘的每一次传中都转化为进球，通过今天的比赛，曼多利尼也发现了，目前球队当中前锋线上靠谱的也就迪甘和帕奇尼两个。
最终曼多利尼还是决定将迪甘当成中锋来使用，如果到了赛季后半段，球队出现伤病的话，也还可以再调整。
有很多球员都非常反感做一个万金油，迪甘却没有这样的怪癖，能踢的位置多了，他获得的机会也将相应的增加，这可是好事，谁会傻呆呆的去对着教练咆哮：“我想要固定的位置！”
好吧！去预备队报道吧！
很快就到了新赛季开始的前一天，这天分组训练之前，所有人的心都悬着，谁都知道，曼多利尼将会在今天宣布明天新赛季第一场比赛主场对战莱切的首发名单。
尽管知道自己的希望很大，可是迪甘还是忍不住阵阵紧张，离开卡卡家的时候，他牛都吹出去了，要在新赛季打败卡卡所效力的AC米兰，如果连首发名单都进不去的话，岂不是糗大了。
“你很紧张吗？”帕奇尼笑呵呵的看着迪甘。
经过这两天的接触，迪甘发现他的好基友就是个没心没肺的蠢蛋，什么事儿都不放在心上，不过他的表情在别人看来，倒像是信心满满的样子。
迪甘没好气的回了一句：“屁话！谁不想做主力球员！”
帕奇尼也不介意，笑道：“放心吧！只要教练还没疯，你的主力位置十拿九稳！”
迪甘也只能在心里默念了一句：但愿如此。
首发门将泰比，这是毫无疑问的，这位仁兄虽然在场上总有些非常有笑点的失误，但是目前在亚特兰大阵中，他绝对是最靠谱的一个了。
四后卫从左到右依次是贝利尼，纳塔利，萨拉和里瓦尔塔，基本上来说要经验有经验，要实力有实力，意大利足球玩儿的就是团队防守，伺机反击，能在意甲球队效力的后位，到了其他联赛都能坐稳主力位置。
贡内拉的神色有些黯然，原本在中后卫的位置上和纳塔利搭档的应该是他，但是那天队内训练赛，防守迪甘之时的拙劣表现，让曼多利尼似乎已经不那么信任他了。
新赛季的首场比赛，派上了曾经效力过AC米兰的老后卫萨拉，估计也是为了求稳。
后腰是当仁不让的阿尔贝蒂尼，尽管年纪大了，又被AC米兰抛弃，但是在这个位置上，他绝对能排的上意甲前五。
岁数大了，身体机能下降了，但是仅仅是依靠经验，阿尔贝蒂尼就足以笑傲意甲赛场了。
左边前卫泽诺尼，右边前卫马尔科利尼，这两人一个曾效力豪门尤文图斯，另一个也是在意甲赛场上拼杀多年的老江湖，将球队的两翼交给他们倒也恰当。
只不过迪甘的心里有些着急了，这意味着他已经失去了一次机会，不过没关系，还有三个名额。

组织型中场蒙托利沃，迪甘虽然失望，但是却也可以理解，和他这个初来乍到的新丁相比，蒙托利沃可是亚特兰大球迷的新王子。
训练场上好几个人的耳朵都竖了起来，等着曼多利尼宣布。
“詹保罗.帕奇尼！”
帕奇尼的脸上掩饰不住的露出了笑容，这是他应得的，在罗西尼离开之后，他就成了亚特兰大锋线上的新希望。
还剩下最后一个名额，曼多利尼没有直接宣布，而是将象征着主力位置的黄背心扔了出去，直接落在了迪甘的怀里。
“罗德！这是你应得的，别让我失望！”
迪甘都还没来得及高兴一下，他喜悦的心情，就被一声怒吼给打破了。
“为什么？教练，我想知道这是为什么？”绍达蒂面色激动的跳了出来，大声怕咆哮着。
曼多利尼的脸色一黑，道：“谁的状态好谁出场，我记得在我刚来贝尔加莫的时候就已经和所有人都说过了。”
“可是我不明白，上个赛季这小子和我们并肩作战过吗？他什么都没做过，而我为了球队能够升级，付出了努力，凭什么他一来就抢走了我的首发位置！”
曼多利尼的脸色越来越难看，身为一个主教练，当着全队的面被自己的球员质疑，这是对他权威的极大挑战。
“卢卡.绍达蒂！我想你应该去预备队冷静一下了，从明天开始一线队不需要你了！”
绍达蒂并没有意识到自己犯了多大的过错，他只是感觉到自己被侮辱了，狠狠的侮辱了，这让他的心里充满了极大的愤怒：“好吧！不需要我了，我倒要看看这两个毛孩子能为亚特兰大做什么！”
绍达蒂走了，曼多利尼的脸色依然难看，转头看向了迪甘，吓得迪甘赶紧把黄背心套在了身上，好像生怕又被曼多利尼收回去一样。
曼多利尼一愣，也是哭笑不得，板着一张脸，道：“罗德！我给了你信任，我想你也该回报我一些东西了！”
潜规则！
菊花残！
不得不佩服迪甘的想象力，这厮的脑子里绝对充满了不健康的东西，好在曼多利尼没有真的对那方面感兴趣。
“明天的比赛，做所有你能做的，让离开的那个蠢货知道，我的选择没有一点儿错误！”
迪甘闻言知道自己是误会了，立刻自信满满的回道：“当然！谁都知道教练的选择一向正确！”
content_en:
Chapter 11 Yellow Vests
In the end, the game could not be played. Probably coach Mandolini couldn't stand the poor performance of some players on the field. He announced the end of the game just ten minutes into the second half.
When he left, Mandolini felt both pain and happiness in his heart. Deegan's performance made him shine, and he was full of hope for the team's prospects in the new season. In addition, Pacini, Lazzari, and the main team's Albertini and Montolivo also performed very well.
But some people really disappointed him, and his performance on the court was not even as good as that of a primary school student. It is foreseeable that some people have completely lost their positions before the new season has started.
Deegan was also very satisfied with his performance today. After that goal, towards the end of the first half, he used a long shot from outside the penalty area to blast away the goal guarded by Taibi.
In the second half, his performance was still eye-catching. First, he passed the ball from the wing, accurately found Pacini at the back point, and pushed the ball into the goal. Then Pacini reciprocated, crossing the penalty area, and assisting Deegan to complete the hat trick.
The main team scored two points from two free kicks by Albertini. In today's world football, when people mention free kick masters, they only think of Beckham's Bayern Curve, but they don't know that Albertini's falling leaves are also unique in the world.
The game was stopped. Although Deegan was not enjoying himself yet, he was helpless. He put his arms around his good friend Pacini and walked towards the locker room laughing.
"Rod! Your performance today was simply great. I can't wait for the new season to start soon and surprise all those first-class teams!"
Deegan smiled and said: "Giampaolo! Don't forget, we are also a first-class team now!"
Pacini was stunned for a moment, then smiled, scratched his head, and said: "If you hadn't reminded me, I would have forgotten it. It's so great. I will also play in Serie A, Rod! We will be the best strike partner in Serie A! The defenses of all teams will be crushed by us!"
"Don't be too proud, you brat! A good performance in a training match means nothing at all. You are still far behind!"
Saudati came over from behind, snorted coldly at the two of them, raised his head and walked over.
Pacini was like Columbus who discovered the New World. He looked at Deegan with confusion: "What's so cool about him? His performance on the court just now was like a clown!"
Degan didn't take it seriously. Of course, the defeated Shiba Inu would bark a few times. The winner would take this seriously: "Ignore him! He must have had his period today. The way he walks, it looks like he is holding a sanitary napkin!"
Pachini burst into laughter at Deegan's description. Neither of them saw that Saudati's face was so dark that they could play Bao Qingtian.
After taking a shower and rejecting Pacini's invitation to have a drink with him, Deegan was about to go home. The new season was about to begin. He didn't want to leave a bad impression on Mandolini because of things outside the stadium.
The Atlanta club rented him a house, which was not far from the team's training ground. Deegan did not drive, but ran back. Now his body has a very good foundation, but it has not been trained. Deegan wants to make a name for himself in the new season, and it is not possible without a good body. He must seize the time to adjust his body to the best condition, and when the season starts, he will surprise everyone.
Deegan left, but Mandolini was left with a difficult problem, which position Deegan should play. Judging from today's performance, winger, organizational midfielder, forward, Deegan can play every position.
This is also thanks to Deegan's rich experience in his previous life. In the beginning, he played as a center. He only changed positions because of his thin body and his miserable height.
The head coach of Chengdu Sheffield United because of his speedQuickly, he was assigned to play as a winger, but Deegan didn't like this position very much, so he became an organizing midfielder again.
If Deegan is placed in the midfield position, although his technical and organizational expertise can be used, it will waste his scoring ability. If he is placed in the winger position, the left channel of the stadium will be occupied, but no one can guarantee that the team's forward can convert every cross from Deegan into a goal. Through today's game, Mandolini also discovered that currently the only two reliable forwards in the team are Deegan and Pacini.
In the end, Mandolini decided to use Deegan as a center. If the team is injured in the second half of the season, it can be adjusted again.
Many players are very averse to being a jack-of-all-trades, but Deegan does not have such a quirk. With more positions that he can play, his opportunities will also increase accordingly. This is a good thing. Who would stupidly yell at the coach: "I want a fixed position!"
Okay! Go report to the reserve team!
Soon it was the day before the start of the new season. Before the group training, everyone's hearts were hanging. Everyone knew that Mandolini would announce today the starting lineup for tomorrow's first game of the new season at home against Lecce.
Although he knew that he had great hopes, Deegan couldn't help but feel nervous. When he left Kaka's house, he boasted that he would defeat AC Milan, where Kaká played for, in the new season. It would be embarrassing if he couldn't even make the starting lineup.
"Are you nervous?" Pachini looked at Deegan with a smile.
After these two days of contact, Deegan found that his good friend was a heartless idiot who didn't care about anything, but his expression seemed to others to be full of confidence.
Deegan replied angrily: "Bullshit! Who doesn't want to be the main player!"
Pacini didn't mind either and said with a smile: "Don't worry! As long as the coach is not crazy, your main position is guaranteed!"
Deegan could only say silently in his heart: I hope so.
There is no doubt about the starting goalkeeper Taibbi. Although this guy always makes some very funny mistakes on the field, he is definitely the most reliable one in Atlanta's lineup.
The four defenders from left to right are Bellini, Natali, Sala and Rivalta. Basically, they need experience and strength. Italian football is all about team defense and waiting for opportunities to counterattack. Those who can play in the back position for Serie A teams can secure their main position in other leagues.
Gonella looked a little gloomy. He was supposed to be partnering with Natali at the center back position, but his poor performance when defending Deegan in the team's training match that day made Mandolini seem not to trust him so much.
In the first game of the new season, veteran defender Sara, who once played for AC Milan, was played, probably for stability.
The defensive midfielder is Albertini who does his job. Although he is old and was abandoned by AC Milan, in this position, he can definitely rank among the top five in Serie A.
As he gets older, his physical functions have declined, but just relying on experience, Albertini is enough to be proud of Serie A.
Zenoni, the left midfielder, and Marcolini, the right midfielder, one of them has played for the giant Juventus, and the other is also a veteran who has been fighting in Serie A for many years. It is appropriate to hand over the two wings of the team to them.
It's just that Deegan was a little anxious, which meant that he had lost an opportunity, but it didn't matter, there were still three places.
Although Deegan is disappointed with the organizational midfielder Montolivo, it is understandable. Compared with him, a newcomer who has just arrived, Montolivo is the new prince of Atlanta fans.
Several people on the training ground had their ears perked up, waiting for Mandolini to announce.
"JamboLo Paccini! "
Pacini couldn't hide a smile on his face. This was what he deserved. After Rossini left, he became Atlanta's new hope on the front line.
With the last spot left, Mandolini did not announce it directly, but threw the yellow vest symbolizing the main position, and it fell directly into Deegan's arms.
"Rhode! You deserve this, don't let me down! "
Before Di Gan could even feel happy, his joyful mood was broken by a roar.
"Why? Coach, I want to know why? Saudati jumped out with excitement and roared loudly.
Mandolini's face darkened and he said: "Whoever is in good condition will play. I remember I told everyone about it when I first came to Bergamo. "
“But I don’t understand, did this kid play with us last season? He has done nothing, and I have worked hard for the team to be promoted. Why did he take away my starting position as soon as he came! "
Mandolini's face became increasingly ugly. As a head coach, being questioned by his own players in front of the entire team was a great challenge to his authority.
"Luca Saudati! I think you should go to the reserve team to calm down. From tomorrow on, the first team won’t need you! "
Saudati didn't realize how big a mistake he had made. He just felt that he had been insulted, severely insulted, which filled his heart with great anger: "Okay! I'm not needed anymore, I want to see what these two idiots can do for Atlanta! "
Saudati left, but Mandolini's face was still ugly. He turned to look at Deegan, who was so scared that Deegan quickly put the yellow vest on his body, as if he was afraid that Mandolini would take it back again.
Mandolini was stunned, and he didn't know whether to laugh or cry. He said with a straight face: "Rhode! I gave you trust, I think it's time for you to repay me with something! "
Hidden rules!
The chrysanthemum is broken!
I have to admire Deegan's imagination. This guy's mind is definitely full of unhealthy things. Fortunately, Mandolini is not really interested in that aspect.
"In tomorrow's game, do everything you can to let the idiot who left know that my choice was not wrong at all! "
Upon hearing this, Deegan knew that he had misunderstood, and immediately replied confidently: "Of course! Everyone knows that the coach’s choice is always correct! "
